scope: P0.1 dynamic LOT characteristics — focused physical Android validation

scenarios.name: DRILL — required Мощность blocks preview
steps: Seller: Продать → Создать ЛОТ → Электроинструмент → Дрели
Before preview: section «Характеристики» visible with required «Мощность»
Attempt continue without value → preview must NOT open
Human message such as «Укажите мощность» (no raw backend error)
Send for moderation → «ЛОТ отправлен на проверку»
Мои ЛОТы → На проверке → LOT exists and opens

scenarios.name: AUTO ACCESSORY — no Производительность false requirement
steps: Create phone holder (Держатели для телефона) or similar auto accessory

scenarios.name: CLOTHING — Размер when required
steps: Clothing-specific characteristics; «Размер» when required by taxonomy

scenarios.name: CATEGORY CHANGE — stale characteristics cleared
steps: Stale Мощность not submitted for clothing
Clothing characteristics load; generic LOT fields remain

scenarios.name: RESTORE — draft persistence after relaunch
steps: Start LOT with dynamic characteristic values
Restore prompt; LOT fields, photo, category/ProductType, characteristics, pickup remain

scenarios.name: MODERATION TRUTH — PENDING_REVIEW end-to-end
steps: Buyer: LOT not in public catalog/PDP until approved

promotionPolicy.onAnyFail: BLOCKED_FOR_BETA — report exact failure; do not auto-build another RC
